places.raw_name: cow camp / the valley where the herd is strung out
places.name: Hat Creek herd camp near Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake and Lorena, in pants, ride in at supper and stun the hands; Jake says they'll travel alongside toward Denver; Call decides to start tomorrow.
places.location_hint: outfit's cook camp beside a long valley or plain where the gathered herd grazes, a short ride from Lonesome Dove in south Texas brush country

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena recalls leaving quietly from the empty Dry Bean while Lippy protested his innocence from the steps.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Bolivar's unhappy wife waits at home there; Call keeps raiding across for easy cattle now that Pedro Flores is gone.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Jake once knew a woman mule skinner there who wore pants, which gave him the idea for Lorena.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Jake announces he and Lorena will try their luck there; Call warns it is a hard trip.

places.name: High Plains
places.note: Jake warns water may get scarce once the drive reaches the plains.
places.location_hint: open plains north of Texas brush country along the trail

places.name: Pickles Gap
places.note: Call supposes Newt has at least been taken there.
places.location_hint: about twelve miles from Lonesome Dove

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Newt boasts he's been north as far as here, once with Deets; Call says the drive goes much farther.

groups.hint: at the cook fire beside the gathered herd, about to start north
